proof_body:
by
  intro m a b c d h
  have aux : ∀ p q r s : ℤ, (p - q) % 2 = 0 → (r - s) % 2 = 0 → p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 + r ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 2 * m → ∃ w x y z : ℤ, w ^ 2 + x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2 = m := by
    intro p q r s hpq hrs hsum
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, p = q + 2 * u := ⟨(p - q) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, r = s + 2 * t := ⟨(r - s) / 2, by omega⟩
    subst hu ht
    exact ⟨u, q + u, t, s + t, by linarith⟩
  have hev : (a + b + c + d) % 2 = 0 := by
    have sq : ∀ t : ℤ, (t ^ 2 - t) % 2 = 0 := by
      intro t
      have e : t ^ 2 - t = t * (t - 1) := by ring
      rw [e]
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one t with ht | ht
      · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, t = 2 * y := ⟨t / 2, by omega⟩
        rw [mul_assoc]; omega
      · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, t = 2 * y + 1 := ⟨t / 2, by omega⟩
        have : (2 * y + 1) * (2 * y + 1 - 1) = 2 * ((2 * y + 1) * y) := by ring
        rw [this]; omega
    have h1 := sq a
    have h2 := sq b
    have h3 := sq c
    have h4 := sq d
    omega
  rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one (a - b) with hab | hab
  · exact aux a b c d hab (by omega) h
  · rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one (a - c) with hac | hac
    · exact aux a c b d hac (by omega) (by linarith)
    · exact aux a d b c (by omega) (by omega) (by linarith)
